record.question: A 50-year-old woman sustains a displaced and angulated fracture through the diaphysis of the right humerus. Following four months of treatment with initially a U-slab and then a humeral brace, the patient has persistent pain and mobility at the fracture site and check radiographs demonstrate no cortex bridging and no callus. What is the most likely diagnosis?
